status: FROZEN once frozen_manifest_v3.json is committed; extends protocol.json (v2) without changing any of its thresholds. Changes need a new version and owner approval.
extends: protocol.json (v2): data, periods, costs, criteria T1-T10, holdout and regime definitions are inherited unchanged
purpose: Phase 4 risk-management research: R1 overlay on TrendEmaCross and MomentumRoc. Research data only (all data before 2025-07-01 is research data); nothing here is validation.

holdout.rule: NOT touched by Phase 4. One single evaluation of R1, only after separate written owner approval, with files identical to frozen_manifest_v3.json. A holdout result never feeds back into any rule or parameter.

candidates.status: research candidates only; MeanReversionRsiBb and BreakoutDonchian stay rejected

R1.rationale: All values set a priori from a risk budget or convention (see docs/phase3b/risk_research_proposal.md); none was tuned on results. They are never swept.

decision_timestamp_rule: Every input (ATR, correlation, BTC regime, equity, open positions, stop-out history) uses only candles that closed strictly before the decision timestamp; BTC regime uses completed days only; an input that cannot be computed means NO entry (fail closed).
sizing: stake = risk_factor * risk_per_trade * equity / (stop_distance + 2*fee + slippage + stop_extra), capped by max_stake_fraction*equity, free cash (incl. fee+slippage), remaining gross-exposure room and the exchange maximum; if below the exchange minimum the trade is skipped, never rounded up. Equity is mark-to-market at closed-candle prices. Entries on the same candle are sized one after another from the updated snapshot.

circuit_breaker.equity: mark-to-market portfolio equity (cash + open positions at last closed price)
circuit_breaker.warn: drawdown from peak >= dd_halve: risk per trade multiplied by halve_factor
circuit_breaker.halt: drawdown from peak >= dd_halt: NO new entries. Latched: it does NOT release when equity recovers. Restart needs an explicit owner approval file naming the halt id. A flat portfolio cannot trade out of a halt.
circuit_breaker.existing_positions: are not force-liquidated; they stay managed by their ATR chandelier stops (and the strategy's exit signals) and may close normally
circuit_breaker.in_backtest: no owner approval is possible, so a halt is terminal for the rest of the run; every RISK_HALT event is reported

ablations.never_used_to: select, rank-to-pick, re-tune or promote a configuration

budget.formula: 2 strategies x (R1 + 6 ablations), each run once at base fee 0.001
budget.stress: recosted on the identical R1 positions with stress fee/slippage (no extra backtest); R0 stress is from its own fee-0.002 backtest (approximation, documented)

set: B1 equal-weight all 8 pairs, never rebalanced (v2 benchmark)
benchmarks.membership_rule: fixed here, before any R1 result exists; chosen from the Phase 3B audit proposal, not from future performance
benchmarks.T3: Sortino of the candidate >= MAX Sortino over B1..B5 (base costs, same period)
benchmarks.T4: max drawdown <= 0.20 AND <= MIN max drawdown over B1..B5 (the 20 % limit is binding)

criteria: T1-T10 exactly as in protocol.json; T9 (parameter robustness) is NOT evaluated in Phase 4 because parameters are frozen and not swept; reported as 'not evaluated'. Phase 4 verdicts are diagnostics on research data, never validation.
failure_conditions: R1 max drawdown not below R0 -> overlay not worth carrying forward
time in market < 25 % -> report as capital preservation without edge
any lookahead/recursive bias finding -> R1 rejected

bias_checks.periods: same six periods and pairs as protocol.json
bias_checks.note: lookahead-analysis cannot see state-dependent overlay decisions fully; the overlay is additionally covered by unit tests (causality: appended future rows change nothing)

approximations_to_document: post-hoc slippage scaled by wallet ratio (apply_costs_consistent); R1 sizing is proportional to equity so this is reasonable but not exact
Freqtrade backtesting sizes with its own wallet which does not pay slippage
stop exits fill at stop price or the candle open when gapped (Freqtrade behaviour), plus stop_extra
stress is recosted on identical positions

R1 reads BTC history for the daily regime from the stored candle file in backtests (exchange startup-candle limit forbids requesting ~6000 candles); it is only sliced to completed days before the decision time. R1 uses startup_candle_count=600, the same warm-up family as R0
